Sam (Sales): Hey team — FinHealth POC ask: EU-only processing + list of sub-processors for their audit; they'd like routing rules that prevent cross-border failover, and a rough POC price for ~2M tokens/month. Can we confirm options and timeline? cc @Priya
Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifying Qs — do they require BYOK for the POC or is standard KMS fine? Also: fully private VPC or is hosted with geo-affinity acceptable?
Eve (Customer): For the POC we prefer no BYOK (keep it simple). Main hard requirement: no data leaves EU. We also need a subproc inventory and a short attestation.
Priya (Solutions Eng): OK — three service options (tradeoffs):
1) Hosted + tenant geofence (fastest to stand up, control plane global but data plane in EU).
2) Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity in EU; stronger isolation + SLA).
3) Private (VPC/on‑prem — most effort, certifiable).
Routing policy examples: we can set affinity + restrict failover to regional-only so traffic never crosses EU boundary. Sample config we can provide:
```
route_policy:
  affinity: eu
  failover: same_region
  subprocessor_whitelist: ["aws-eu-west-1", "gcp-europe-west1"]
```
Priya (Solutions Eng): Also FYI: control-plane telemetry (non-customer PII) is aggregated centrally — we can include opt-out for the POC and provide logs retention in region on request.
Jordan (Legal): I can prepare the sub-processor inventory and an attestation letter once infra confirms the active list. We should include the standard data processing addendum + export control clause.
Kai (Infra): For the hosted geofence option: data plane endpoints are in eu-central/eu-west. Control plane signaling may go through our central control plane (no sensitive payload). I'll attach the network path diagram and cert chain to the runbook. Note about failover: fully isolated failover (EU-only) means we disable cross-border fallthrough — acceptable but reduces global capacity headroom.
Marta (Pricing): Ballpark pricing: hosted geofence for 2M tokens/mo ~ $900/mo; dedicated reserved reduces unit cost ~35%-45% depending on commit — rough target ~$550/mo with a monthly commit. Need model size and concurrency to firm numbers.
Sam (Sales): @Marta can you make that a proper quote? Also the customer needs confirmation on subproc list and a 3-business-day turnaround on attestation. Possible?
Marta (Pricing): I can do it — send me peak RPS and model (quantized vs fp16).
Eve (Customer): Peak RPS for POC ~ 8–12 rps. Llama‑2‑13B quant is acceptable as baseline.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Great — next steps proposed: 1) Confirm BYOK=false and model = Llama‑2‑13B quant; 2) Infra produces network diagram + subproc whitelist; 3) Legal drafts attestation and DPA addendum; 4) Pricing issues draft quote. I can assemble a 1‑page POC playbook and test script.
Kai (Infra): Uploading network diagram to the handoff folder now (link: https://redwood.internal/handbooks/finhealth-netdiag). Note: egress costs if cross-region happen — we should flag to customer.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick test command I'll include in playbook (curl example to pin tenant to EU):
```
curl -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"tenant":"finhealth","region":"eu-west"}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/pin
```
Sam (Sales): Can Legal confirm attestation turnaround? @Jordan
Jordan (Legal): 3 business days OK assuming infra confirms subproc list today. I'll start the attestation draft.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Ops note: to meet EU-only requirement we will set route_policy.failover = "same_region" and enable prefix/KV cache residency in-region. Will also add a canary that forces traffic to EU-only model variant for the POC.
Eve (Customer): That sounds good. Also can you include a simple SLA for latency targets for the POC? We need a baseline for our internal eval.
Priya (Solutions Eng): We'll include a POC SLA section: 95th latency target (single-turn) + error budget for model retries. I'll add measured numbers from a small perf test.
Marta (Pricing): One more ask from pricing ops — any special compliance add-ons (SOC2/ISO retention, longer logs retention) will change pricing. Call out what they want.
Eve (Customer): We need SOC2 audit artifacts and 90-day audit log retention for the POC.
Jordan (Legal): Noted — include in attestation; price impact flagged.
Sam (Sales): Timeline: aim to start provisioning next Tue, POC kickoff Wed. Everyone ok?
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll prep the playbook by EOD tomorrow.
Kai (Infra): I'll confirm subproc whitelist + upload certs by EOD today.
Marta (Pricing): I'll send a draft quote by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan (Legal): Attestation draft in 3 business days.
Eve (Customer): :thumbsup: Thanks all, looking forward to the playbook and quote.
